about: Curated review list for the new site's translations, read by scripts/export-content.mjs: a unit listed here gets status "needs-review" and this note. Keys are "<lang>:<key>" (or "*:<key>" for en, fr and it). Units whose German numbers are missing in a translation are flagged automatically. Background: content/i18n/divergence-report.md, section C.

units.fr:home.hero.outro: Adds «unique» (DE: «ist ein Erlebnis»), copied from the live French page. Suggest «… est une expérience pour les amoureux de la cuisine italienne».
units.it:home.hero.outro: Says «il posto ideale» (DE: «ist ein Erlebnis»), copied from the live Italian page. Suggest «… è un’esperienza per gli amanti della cucina italiana».
units.it:home.story.title: «la pizzeria del buon gusto» (of good taste) does not mean «die aparte Pizzeria» (distinctive). It is the restaurant's own Italian line; owners to decide.
units.en:meta.descriptions.reserve: «daily from 10:00 to 23:00»: the source says «jeweils von 10 bis 23 Uhr», and Wednesday is Ruhetag. Drop «daily» unless the owners confirm.
units.fr:meta.descriptions.reserve: «tous les jours de 10 h à 23 h»: the source says «jeweils von 10 bis 23 Uhr», and Wednesday is Ruhetag. Drop «tous les jours» unless the owners confirm.
units.it:meta.descriptions.reserve: «ogni giorno dalle 10 alle 23»: the source says «jeweils von 10 bis 23 Uhr», and Wednesday is Ruhetag. Drop «ogni giorno» unless the owners confirm.
units.fr:home.reserve.body: «tous les jours de 10 h à 23 h»: see meta.descriptions.reserve.
units.en:reserve.phoneBody: Adds «daily». The source says «jeweils von 10 bis 23 Uhr», and the live English page says only «from 10:00 to 23:00».
units.fr:reserve.phoneBody: Adds «tous les jours». The source says «jeweils von 10 bis 23 Uhr», and the live French page says only «de 10h00 à 23h00».
units.fr:hours.closureText: Typography: «du 1 novembre» → «du 1er novembre»; «le vendredi, 18 décembre» → «le vendredi 18 décembre».
